name: Segment by Points or Box
description: Cuts one object out of the picture as a mask (white is the object). Say where it is with points inside it (Include points), points on what must stay out (Exclude points) and/or a Box around it, all in the picture's pixels. Wire the mask to Inpaint, Crop to Mask or Composite Masked. SAM 2.1 through ONNX Runtime.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.description: A SAM 2.1 bundle (.zip with an encoder and a decoder). The picker offers the downloads, with their licence shown first.

inputs.name: positive
inputs.label: Include points
inputs.description: Points inside the object, one per line: x y, in pixels from the picture's top left (x goes right, y goes down). Add one on every part the first mask missed.

inputs.name: negative
inputs.label: Exclude points
inputs.description: Points on what must stay out of the mask, one per line: x y.

inputs.name: box
inputs.label: Box
inputs.description: A box around the object: x1 y1 x2 y2, two opposite corners in pixels. With a box, Include points are optional. Several lines are several objects, joined in one mask (wire Find by Text's Boxes here); then leave the points empty.

inputs.name: invert
inputs.label: Invert
inputs.description: Give everything but the object as the mask.

inputs.name: soft
inputs.label: Soft edge
inputs.description: Give the model's confidence (gray at the edge) instead of a hard black and white edge.

inputs.name: device
inputs.description: Auto uses the GPU when the pack's environment has the CUDA build of ONNX Runtime.
